text: 近日，上海国投先导公示对上海智微凌峰创业投资合伙企业（有限合伙）的投资。该基金由智微资本担任管理人，目标规模30亿元。LP阵容汇聚中微公司、澜起科技等半导体龙头的旗下平台，工业X射线检测领域企业日联科技的子公司，以及地方国资平台，形成“产业资本+国有资本”的深度联合。智微凌峰基金以半导体设备、零部件、材料及先进封装等集成电路核心环节为主攻方向，重点挖掘“卡脖子”领域的“隐形冠军”。
text_en: Recently, Shanghai Guotou Pilot disclosed its investment in Shanghai Zhiwei Lingfeng Venture Capital Partnership (Limited Partnership). The fund, managed by Zhiwei Capital, has a target size of 3 billion yuan. Its LP lineup brings together platforms under semiconductor leaders including AMEC and Montage Technology, a subsidiary of industrial X-ray inspection firm Nuctech, as well as local state-owned capital platforms, forming a deep alliance of 'industrial capital + state capital.' Zhiwei Lingfeng Fund focuses on core integrated circuit segments such as semiconductor equipment, components, materials, and advanced packaging, with an emphasis on uncovering 'hidden champions' in 'bottleneck' areas.
